AboutPage.title: About this demo
AboutPage.intro: This page explains how the multilingual demo is assembled, which mechanisms it demonstrates, and which trade-offs were accepted.

mechanisms.routing: Locale-prefixed routing with next-intl and the App Router, statically rendered per locale.
mechanisms.detection: Edge middleware detects the visitor's language from a cookie or the Accept-Language header.
mechanisms.rtl: Arabic switches the document to right-to-left; logical CSS properties mirror the layout automatically.
mechanisms.formatting: Dates, numbers, currencies, and plurals flow through ICU message catalogs shared by server and client.
mechanisms.seo: Canonical links, hreflang alternates, a localized sitemap, and per-locale metadata.
mechanisms.testing: Unit tests with Vitest and Testing Library plus end-to-end browser tests with Playwright.

tradeoffs.prefix: Always-prefixed URLs cost a redirect on first visit but keep one URL per language, which simplifies caching and SEO.
tradeoffs.detection: Automatic detection can guess wrong; the switcher and the preference cookie make the guess correctable in one click.
tradeoffs.library: next-intl couples the app to one library, but it is the de-facto standard for App Router i18n and avoids hand-rolled routing bugs.
